items.source: Constructor with a ConversionService and a BeanFactory.
items.translation: 带有 `ConversionService` 和 `BeanFactory` 的构造函数。

items.source: Create the AbstractNamedValueMethodArgumentResolver.NamedValueInfo object for the given method parameter. Implementations typically retrieve the method annotation by means of MethodParameter.getParameterAnnotation(Class).
items.translation: 为给定的方法参数创建 AbstractNamedValueMethodArgumentResolver.NamedValueInfo 对象。实现通常通过 MethodParameter.getParameterAnnotation(Class) 获取方法注解。

items.source: Description copied from interface: HandlerMethodArgumentResolver
Create the AbstractNamedValueMethodArgumentResolver.NamedValueInfo object for the given method parameter.
items.translation: 为给定的方法参数创建AbstractNamedValueMethodArgumentResolver.NamedValueInfo对象。

items.source: Invoked after a value is resolved.
Resolves a method parameter into an argument value from a given message.
items.translation: 将方法参数解析为来自给定消息的参数值。

items.source: Resolves the given parameter type and value name into an argument value.
items.translation: 将给定的参数类型和值名解析为参数值。

items.source: resolveArgument in interface HandlerMethodArgumentResolver

parameter - the method parameter to resolve. This parameter must have previously been passed to HandlerMethodArgumentResolver.supportsParameter(org.springframework.core.MethodParameter) which must have returned true.
items.translation: parameter - 要解析的方法参数。此参数必须先前已传递给HandlerMethodArgumentResolver.supportsParameter(org.springframework.core.MethodParameter)，且该调用必须返回true。

items.source: A default value string can contain ${...} placeholders and Spring Expression Language #{...} expressions which will be resolved if a ConfigurableBeanFactory is supplied to the class constructor.
items.translation: 默认值字符串可以包含 `${...}` 占位符和 Spring 表达式语言 #{...} 表达式，如果向类构造函数提供了 ConfigurableBeanFactory，这些表达式将被解析。

items.source: A ConversionService is used to convert a resolved String argument value to the expected target method parameter type.
items.translation: 一个ConversionService用于将解析后的字符串参数值转换为预期的目标方法参数类型。

items.source:
Subclasses only need to define specific steps such as how to obtain named
value details from a method parameter, how to resolve to argument values, or
how to handle missing values.
items.translation: 子类只需定义特定步骤，例如如何从方法参数获取命名值详情、如何将参数解析为值，或如何处理缺失的值。

items.source: Invoked when a value is required, but resolveArgumentInternal(MethodParameter, Message, String) returned null and there is no default value.
items.translation: 在需要值但resolveArgumentInternal(MethodParameter, Message, String)返回了null且没有默认值时调用。

items.source: Invoked when a value is required, but resolveArgumentInternal(MethodParameter, Message, String) returned null and there is no default value. Subclasses can throw an appropriate exception for this case.
items.translation: 当需要某个值，但resolveArgumentInternal(MethodParameter, Message, String)返回了null且没有默认值时，会触发此事件。子类可以针对这种情况抛出适当的异常。

items.source: Represents a named value declaration.
beanFactory - a bean factory for resolving ${...} placeholders and #{...} SpEL expressions in default values
items.translation: beanFactory - 用于解析默认值中的 ${...} 占位符和 #{...} SpEL 表达式的 BeanFactory。

items.source: Exception - in case of errors with the preparation of argument values
items.translation: Exception - 在准备参数值时发生错误的情况下

items.source: Exception - in case of errors
items.translation: Exception - 在发生错误时

items.source: conversionService - conversion service for converting String values to the target method parameter type
items.translation: conversionService - 用于将 String 值转换为目标方法参数类型的转换服务
